http.instructions: Send JSON {tool, arguments}. HTTP retry identity belongs in the Idempotency-Key header, never arguments.idempotency_key; MCP uses idempotency_key inside its tool arguments.

arguments_schema.description: Read the context vault: durable facts and temporary context with source, confidence and expiry. Unknown and expired values are null. Needs context.read; never acquires location or calls a model.

arguments.description: Read the context vault: durable facts and temporary context with source, confidence and expiry. Unknown and expired values are null. Needs context.read; never acquires location or calls a model.

tool.description: Dotted tool name, e.g. screen.observe (x-bridgit-tools lists the MCP names: drop the bridgit_ prefix and use dots)
